title: Active rule-set pointer (dist/<os>/<arch>/active.json)
description: Written by `rules.py activate|rollback --pointer-dir dist/<os>/<arch>`. apg_create() / apg_reload() accept this file instead of a manifest path: the pointer is resolved to <dir>/<manifest> and, if manifest_sha256 is set, the manifest file must hash to it (a stale pointer is refused).

manifest.description: Relative path below the pointer's directory
